additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416275-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S0 170004106] DC Plug-In - CCS2 300 kW PP7 - Unavailable CRM:02678000044
additional_info.body:
Hello Jose,
Hope you are doing well.
The issue of all outlets unavailable was reported by customer
Mr. Michael Brogioli
from
Holcim (Schweiz) AG
. We’ve checked the error flags on the SCB, and they indicate that the door is open. Please confirm if this is the case. If the door isn’t actually open, there may be an issue with the sensor.
Additionally, we need site intervention to check for the following:
We need to investigate if any of the following connections are loose/Faulty.
Also, need to check if Door Switches are functioning properly or not (if required, consider replacing; Recommended to have spares)
If QA26 is tripped, we need to reset it by pressing the button.
Also, please carry a spare part MLFB-3SE5232-0HC05, while visiting the site.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0416275 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
CH
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason

Yes

Yes

Yes

Performance monitoring by RC
